map.summary:
The owner settled the shape of the dailies on 20 and 21 Oct 2026. There are three dailies a day (Easy, Medium, Hard), each the same for everyone at that level. The calendar also gets harder from Monday to Saturday for everyone. Sunday is the week plus one look-again pair ("What was different?") and an optional private note. The streak forgives one missed day a week. Five worlds take a week each (Lugdi, Station, Jadugar, Cricket, Rukavat). Each level has its own Today, This week and All time boards. Fairness is scored both ways, and the player sees only the size of the lean, never its side.

The 25 and 26 Oct decisions were mostly about the First take, but several of them reach the dailies:
- The First take became a "story mode" with no time cap. The dailies are recorded as "daily challenges", but nobody has written down how that changes them.
- Cards must carry jobs most people can do. This clashes with the "women truck drivers as deliberate satire" line in PRODUCT.md and F-43, and with the draft fortnight's content.
- "Just the look" (worlds are only a look) is recorded for chapters only.
- The player is now the 22 to 30-year-old of the house. That makes content/story.md's five-week arcs and week-change cutscenes out of date.

The dailies section of the ground-rules draft (rules 53 to 61) is new and waits for the owner's yes, including:
- what Easy, Medium and Hard mean;
- a returning pair coming back next week on the same weekday and level;
- the lean moving only when a pair finishes;
- whether 5 to 7 minutes covers one daily or all three.

What exists for the dailies:
- **Decisions on paper** (PRODUCT.md, feature-set.md, design-rules-consolidated.md). Several are out of date: PRODUCT.md still says one puzzle a day and two alternating worlds.
- **The old build's engine** (score, streak, calendar, results, board). It is built but the live app does not use it. It also breaks several decisions: two worlds by ISO week parity, a midnight day end instead of 4 am, a date override, and every day bundled into the JS.
- **An unreviewed one-level fortnight** in Lugdi and Station only.
- **Some library drawings** for the result, Week and Sunday. The library cover still draws "Level 3 of 6", and no Easy/Medium/Hard switch is drawn anywhere.

On honest claims: the reading is not validated. No screen may say "bias", "test" or "attitude", or any research word. No result may label the player. Nothing may claim that a change happened until the research line sets the threshold. The store title gains "daily" only once the dailies ship (owner, 27 Oct).
